text:
Maya: quick sync — we need to lock scope for the cross-region sandbox for Q2. customer asks keep routing isolation per-tenant but lower-cost default. thoughts?
Alejandra: +1. two options: (1) strong tenant isolation lanes (higher cost) or (2) soft slices with fallback policies and throttles.
Sam: can we quantify cost delta? ops asked for a 15% unit-cost target vs current baseline.
Maya: rough estimate: lanes ~30% extra infra; soft slices + smarter routing ~10-12% if we accept slightly higher cold-start risk.
John L: customer SLA ask: 99.9% regional availability and cross-region failover within 5s for market-critical tenants. that pushes us toward dedicated lanes for those tenants.
Alejandra: agreed. propose: tiered policy — Tier A tenants get dedicated lane + regional affinity; Tier B get soft-slice w/ KV prefix caching + prioritized scheduling.
Sam: sounds reasonable. what's the launch criteria? minimal viable sandbox should include: routing policy config UI, per-tenant assignment API, and fallback rules.
Maya: exactly. add measurable gates: latency p95 < 120ms for Tier A baseline, failover tested in canary, and billing estimates validated.
Alejandra: also add rollback triggers: if fallback rate > 5% in canary -> block rollout.
John L: customers asking for encryption-at-rest KMS per-tenant in private deployments — that's an add-on, not blocking sandbox MVP. document in scope backlog.
Maya: regarding implementation, infra wants a small prototype using labels and a routing-policy table. Sam can we scope an RFC?
Sam: I'll open RFC today. initial config sketch: 
```
routing_policy:
  - tenant_id: T-123
    tier: A
    affinity: region-us-east-1
    fallback: model-variant-lowcost
```
I'll include cost simulation.
Alejandra: timeline? we need a customer pilot by end of Q2. does that fit dev capacity?
Maya: timeline OK if we cut following: no immediate per-tenant KMS, no per-token billing changes. focus on routing + fallback + telemetry.
John L: what about multi-region cache coherence for KV prefix cache? that's the trickiest bit; need SRE input.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster provision requested (req-1482). ETA 3d.
Sam: tagging action items: 1) RFC (Sam) 2) cost model (Sam + Finance) 3) canary infra (SRE) 4) telemetry dashboard (Maya) 5) customer pilot plan (Alejandra).
Maya: I'll schedule a 30m decision session Thursday to finalize tier definitions and gating metrics. please review RFC before then. :calendar:
Alejandra: noted. I'll draft pilot success criteria and customer communication. :memo:
John L: thumbs up. one more ask — include an opt-in flag for private deployments to force dedicated lanes (legal/compliance customers).
Maya: will include. thanks everyone.
Sam: RFC link when done: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1769 (will post) :link:
